description: Stadtwerke Husum Abwasserentsorgung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Inspire Meta-Dataset on Annex3 para. 6 Wastewater disposal. The sewage network in the area of the city of Husum is operated by the own operation of the city of Husum “Stadtwerke Husum Wastewater Disposal”. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal utilities Husum Wastewater disposal" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Schleswig-Holstein, Versorgungsgebiete, Stadtwerke Husum, Abwasser, Versorgung. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
